title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Technical Support Engineer
Residential Energy Storage Systems
Job Summary
Renogy is seeking a motivated Technical Support Engineer to support our growing Residential Energy Storage Systems (ESS) business. As the technical expert for post-sales support, you will resolve complex field issues, enable installers through training, support product validation, and turn Voice of Customer feedback into ...product improvements.
Working across installers, distributors, and customers alongside our Product, Engineering, Quality, and Operations teams-you will combine strong troubleshooting skills with excellent communication to solve real-world technical challenges and ensure the successful deployment of Renogy energy storage solutions.
Key Responsibilities
• Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Provide advanced post-sales support via phone, email, remote diagnostics, and on-site visits for residential ESS products-batteries, inverters, solar panels, communication networks, and monitoring platforms-diagnosing root causes and driving issues to resolution with customers, installers, distributors, and service partners.
• Installer Enablement & Training: Develop and deliver installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting training and certification programs for installers and partners; create technical bulletins and knowledge base content; and train internal Sales, Support, and RMA teams on new products.
• Product Validation & Testing: Reproduce field issues in a controlled environment, validate new products and firmware releases, and support engineering with verification and reliability testing for product launches.
• RMA Management: Own the technical evaluation and resolution of RMA cases, coordinating with repair centers and internal teams; identify recurring failure patterns and drive corrective and preventive actions with Quality and Engineering.
• Technical Documentation: Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, FAQs, installation manuals, and service procedures that improve field installation quality and reduce support cases.
• Voice of Customer (VOC): Collect and analyze feedback from installers, distributors, and end users, and partner with Product Management and Engineering to prioritize field-driven product improvements.
• Standards & Compliance: Stay current with codes, standards, and certification requirements; monitor utility and incentive programs (e.g., SGIP, VPP) and provide technical input to support product qualification and new business opportunities.
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 0–3 years of experience in technical support, field service, applications, test, or product/quality engineering. Recent graduates with strong relevant internships or projects are encouraged to apply.
• Solid grasp of electrical fundamentals with hands-on troubleshooting ability.
• Strong written and verbal communication, with confidence working directly with customers and partners.
• Self-motivated team player with strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

title: Solar Sales Manager
description:
Renogy is seeking a Solar Sales Manager in Montclair, CA, to drive growth in home energy solar solutions. The role involves developing sales strategies, achieving revenue targets, and fostering customer relationships. Responsibilities include market analysis, managing the sales pipeline, collaborating with teams, and representing the company at events. Candidates should have a bachelor's degree, 2...+ years of sales experience, and knowledge of solar products and financing options.
Solar Sales Manager
Renogy aims to become a global leader of independent clean energy solutions. We are seeking and empowering talents to build a team of world-class product innovation and development by fully leveraging clean energy ecosystem to better engage with customers to drive clean energy love and product innovation. Our goal is to empower sustainable living and energy independence by developing the world's most plug & play renewable energy products for mobile living (off-grid), home energy storage and industry applications.
Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Solar Sales Manager to drive the growth of our home energy solar solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in solar sales and business development. You will be responsible for developing sales strategies, achieving revenue targets, and fostering long-term customer relationships while coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.
Duties and Responsibilities:
This position will be responsible for leading a variety of projects and day-to-day company operations including, but not limited to:
• Develop and implement effective sales strategies to expand the company's solar customer base.
• Identify new business opportunities, including residential, commercial, and industrial solar projects.
• Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to refine sales approaches.
• Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including contractors, developers, and government agencies.
• Oversee the sales pipeline, ensuring high conversion rates from lead generation to closing deals.
• Work closely with the marketing team to generate high-quality leads through campaigns, referrals, and partnerships.
• Address customer concerns, negotiate contracts, and ensure customer satisfaction throughout the sales process.
• Collaborate with installation and operations teams to ensure smooth project execution.
• Conduct market research, monitor competitor activities, and report on industry trends to refine sales strategies.
• Contribute to pricing strategies, promotional campaigns, and sales/marketing plans.
• Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, and networking events to enhance brand visibility and generate leads.
• Prepare and present sales reports, forecasts, and performance metrics to senior management.
• Use data-driven insights to optimize sales processes and improve efficiency.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and sales best practices.
Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field (preferred).
• 2+ years of sales experience, with at least 1 year in solar energy sales or renewable energy sector.
• Strong client-facing and technical proposal development abilities.
• Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics tools.
• In-depth knowledge of solar products, financing options (leases, PPAs, loans), and government incentives.
• Ability to build relationships with clients and industry partners.
• Fluent in English and Chinese; public speaking skills for industry events.
Working Conditions:
• Will sit, stand, or walk short distances for up to the entire duration of a shift.
• Will lift, push, or pull up to 40 pounds on an occasional basis.
• Required to use hands to grasp, lift, handle, carry or feel objects on a frequent basis.
• Must be able to comply with all safety standards and procedures.
• May reach above shoulder heights and below the waist on a frequent basis.
• May stoop, kneel, or bend, on an occasional basis.
• Hours occasionally exceed 40 hours per week.
Other
• Other duties as assigned.

description:

Candidates should be fluent in Mandarin and English, possess strong project management skills, and be willing to travel frequently. Customer Success Manager - OEM
Renogy aims to become a global leader of independent clean energy solution. We are seeking and empowering talents to build a team of world-class product innovation and development by fully leveraging clean energy ecosystem to better engage with customers to drive clean energy love and product innovation. From small power banks to complete solar kits, we pride ourselves on supplying top-of-the-line off-grid solar equipment.
Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Customer Success Manager - OEM to support our Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) partners. This role is critical in managing relationships, ensuring seamless communication between our OEM customers and internal teams, and driving the success of projects.
Based near Elkhart, Indiana, or with flexibility to travel, the ideal candidate will have strong project management expertise, fluency in Mandarin and English, and a passion for off-grid energy solutions. This position reports to the Director of Sales & Marketing and collaborates closely with the Regional Sales Manager to win and maintain OEM business.
Duties and Responsibilities:
This position will be responsible for leading a variety of activities including, but not limited to:
• Visit OEM partners on-site to understand their needs, address concerns, and gather actionable feedback.
• Serve as a liaison between OEM customers and headquarters in China, providing detailed reports and updates.
• Lead and manage OEM-related projects, ensuring timely execution and alignment with business goals.
• Support the Regional Sales Manager in identifying opportunities, addressing customer inquiries, and closing deals.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that customer requirements are communicated clearly and met effectively.
• Provide expertise in off-grid energy solutions to educate and support OEM customers.
• Monitor project progress, identify roadblocks, and proactively resolve issues.
Qualifications:
• Fluency in Mandarin and English to facilitate seamless communication with headquarters and OEM customers.
• Strong project management skills with a track record of handling complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
• Flexibility to travel frequently and spend extended periods in Elkhart, Indiana, as required.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build trust with customers and internal teams.
• Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
• Knowledge of off-grid energy solutions or a related technical field is highly preferred.
• Ability to work collaboratively and adapt to a dynamic business environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
• Experience in OEM partnerships, customer success, or account management.
• Familiarity with the RV or off-grid energy market is a plus.
